title.zh: Meta Muse 聊天分享链接被曝公开可查，Meta 暂停该功能
title.en: Meta Muse chat-sharing links found publicly discoverable; Meta pauses feature

current_state.zh: Meta 已恢复 Muse 的对话分享功能。此前 Claroc 研究人员发现公开可访问的 Muse 聊天链接可暴露敏感材料，Meta 随后暂停了该功能；现在分享功能已重新开启。
current_state.en: Meta has restored Muse conversation sharing. The feature had been paused after Claroc researchers showed that publicly accessible Muse chat links could expose sensitive material; sharing is now re-enabled.

updates.title_zh: 研究人员在网上发现 AI 聊天记录后，Meta 暂停 Muse 分享功能
updates.title_en: Meta pauses Muse sharing after researchers find AI chats on the web
updates.what_changed_zh:
Meta 表示已暂停 Muse 的一项分享功能——该功能允许用户分享与这款 AI 助手的对话。此前，安全公司 Claroc 的研究人员通过公开的 DNS 记录发现了超过 6,800 条可公开访问的 Muse 聊天链接，Ars Technica 报道了这一消息。Claroc 本周发布了相关报告。

这次暂停是针对一起隐私暴露事件的产品层面应对，而用户此前可能以为这些对话只在小范围内被分享。

据报道，这些链接是通过公开的 DNS 记录被定位到的，而非由 Meta 主动披露。Meta 称该分享功能为“暂停”，并非永久移除。
updates.what_changed_en: Meta paused its Muse conversation-sharing feature after Claroc researchers discovered more than 6,800 publicly accessible Muse chat links through public DNS records.

updates.detailed_summary_en: Meta paused its Muse conversation-sharing feature after Claroc researchers discovered more than 6,800 publicly accessible Muse chat links through public DNS records.
updates.background_zh: Meta 推出 Muse 时将其定位为面向普通用户的个人 AI 智能体，并在发布时宣传其安全、可靠且注重隐私。与 AI 助手分享对话是各大聊天机器人产品的常见功能，这也使得链接是否容易被发现成为平台反复面临的隐私问题。
updates.background_en: Meta introduced Muse as a consumer-facing personal AI agent, promoting it at launch as safe, secure and private. Sharing conversations with an AI assistant is a common feature across major chatbot products, which makes link discoverability a recurring privacy concern for platforms.

references.title: Introducing Muse: The World’s First Personal AI Agent Built for Everyone

updates.title_en: Meta turns Muse sharing back on
updates.what_changed_zh: Meta 已重新启用 Muse 的对话分享功能；此前该功能因公开链接可暴露敏感文档而被暂停。
updates.what_changed_en: Meta re-enabled Muse conversation sharing after the feature had been paused because public links could expose sensitive documents.
updates.current_state_zh: Meta 已恢复 Muse 的对话分享功能。此前 Claroc 研究人员发现公开可访问的 Muse 聊天链接可暴露敏感材料，Meta 随后暂停了该功能；现在分享功能已重新开启。
updates.current_state_en: Meta has restored Muse conversation sharing. The feature had been paused after Claroc researchers showed that publicly accessible Muse chat links could expose sensitive material; sharing is now re-enabled.
updates.detailed_summary_zh: Meta restored Muse conversation sharing after security researchers showed that publicly accessible links could expose sensitive documents such as internal revenue reviews and loan applications.
updates.detailed_summary_en: Meta restored Muse conversation sharing after security researchers showed that publicly accessible links could expose sensitive documents such as internal revenue reviews and loan applications.
